name: @qu/push-client
description: The browser-side half of Web Push: subscribe/unsubscribe via the Push API against a relay's VAPID key, and forward a service worker's notification-click into an in-page navigation. Used by both the shell (registers the click listener) and any notification-settings app (subscribe/unsubscribe UI) - see @qu/push for the Node-only sending half this pairs with.
